name: Prop
formula: =LAMBDA(points,[unit],LET(shapeArr, points, strUnit, IF(ISOMITTED(unit), "mm", unit), PropTitles, VSTACK("Area", "Centroid X Coor", "Centroid Y Coor", "Distance between Top Fibre to Centroid, yt,", "Distance between Bottom Fibre to Centroid, yb,", "Distance between Left Fibre to Centroid, xl,", "Distance between Right Fibre to Centroid, xr,", "2nd Moment of Area about x-axis Ixx", "2nd Moment of Area about y-axis Iyy", "Polar Moment of Area Ixy", "Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis at Top Fibre, Zxt", "Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis at Bottom Fibre, Zxb", "Elastic Section Modulus about y-axis at Left Fibre, Zyl", "Elastic Section Modulus about y-axis at Right Fibre, Zyr", "Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis, Zxx", "Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis, Zyy"), Units, VSTACK(strUnit & "2", strUnit, strUnit, strUnit, strUnit, strUnit, strUnit, strUnit & "4", strUnit & "4", strUnit & "4", strUnit & "3", strUnit & "3", strUnit & "3", strUnit & "3", strUnit & "3", strUnit & "3"), x, CHOOSECOLS(shapeArr, 1), y, CHOOSECOLS(shapeArr, 2), xShift, VSTACK(DROP(x, 1), TAKE(x, 1)), yShift, VSTACK(DROP(y, 1), TAKE(y, 1)), area, SUM(x * yShift - y * xShift) / 2, Cx, SUM((x + xShift) * (x * yShift - y * xShift)) / (6 * area), Cy, SUM((y + yShift) * (x * yShift - y * xShift)) / (6 * area), xMin, MIN(x), xMax, MAX(x), yMin, MIN(y), yMax, MAX(y), yt, yMax - Cy, yb, Cy - yMin, xl, Cx - xMin, xr, xMax - Cx, Ixx, ABS(SUM((x * yShift - xShift * y) * (y ^ 2 + y * yShift + yShift ^ 2)) / 12), Iyy, ABS(SUM((x * yShift - xShift * y) * (x ^ 2 + x * xShift + xShift ^ 2)) / 12), Ixy, ABS(SUM((x * yShift - xShift * y) * (x * yShift + 2 * x * y + 2 * xShift * yShift + xShift * yShift)) / 24), Zxt, Ixx / yt, Zxb, Ixx / yb, Zyl, Iyy / xl, Zyr, Iyy / xr, Zxx, MIN(Zxt, Zxb), Zyy, MIN(Zyl, Zyr), Props, VSTACK(ABS(area), Cx, Cy, yt, yb, xl, xr, Ixx, Iyy, Ixy, Zxt, Zxb, Zyl, Zyr, Zxx, Zyy), output, HSTACK(PropTitles, Props, Units), output))
